numbers: 玻璃罐为三个月前（原九月）；野猪驮马般大

facts.fact: 独处时感到：皮下刺痒如童年蜘蛛掠脸——「错误感、小腿」
摸脚掌硬物：像茧不是茧；一闪知道是羊皮纸壳卷在肉里——一直未愈
facts.anchor: some shell-curls of parchment had come loose in my flesh
facts.verbatim: some shell-curls of parchment had come loose in my flesh

facts.fact: 指甲抠疤、不痛；拉下厚皮、红新皮、血涌；拇指探——没有异物，只有她自己嘶哭的肉
facts.anchor: finally I could see the wound
facts.verbatim: finally I could see the wound

facts.fact: 抬眼：洞中不止我们——裸白女人坐泉源旁、深毛覆身（传说与雕像上的野猪，驮马般大、头搁膝、眼流珍珠母泪）
facts.anchor: It was you. Not my breathy imaginings, but you.
facts.verbatim: It was you. Not my breathy imaginings, but you.

facts.fact: 刀在月光里、刃凉贴太阳穴；她吸入紫罗兰（压书页间的气味）
facts.anchor: the knife shone in the moonlight
facts.verbatim: the knife shone in the moonlight

facts.fact: 真品瑕疵：一眼略小、发油、嘴周纹——「从不知的瑕疵」
剖胸取心：不看一眼、在腹上擦手、举起跳动的心咬一口
facts.anchor: You raised my thrumming, panicked heart to your teeth and took a bite.
facts.verbatim: You raised my thrumming, panicked heart to your teeth and took a bite.
